test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As per the Periodic Labour Force data 2023, which of the following states recorded the highest unemployment rate in urban areas for the age group 15 years and above?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) 2023**, **Himachal Pradesh** recorded the **highest unemployment rate** in urban areas for individuals aged **15 years and above**.
 
• The PLFS is conducted by the **National Statistical Office (NSO)** under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, Government of India.
 
• Himachal Pradesh, despite being a state with a strong tourism sector and agricultural base, has faced challenges in generating sufficient employment opportunities in **urban regions**.
 
• Urban areas in Himachal Pradesh have experienced a rise in unemployment due to limited industrial development and dependency on seasonal industries such as tourism.
 
• **Unemployment rate** refers to the percentage of persons in the labour force who are unemployed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chhattisgarh**__

 __
 
• Chhattisgarh has a predominantly **rural economy**, and unemployment rates in urban areas are generally lower compared to other states.
 
• It is known for its **mining and mineral resources** and has contributed significantly to the industrial sector.
 
• Employment opportunities in Chhattisgarh are largely driven by its **agriculture and forestry-based industries.**
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan**__
 __
 
• Rajasthan has a significant portion of its economy dependent on **tourism, handicrafts, and agriculture.**
 
• Urban unemployment in Rajasthan is generally moderate, but challenges arise due to the state's **arid climate and limited industrial base.**
 
• Rajasthan has also focused on promoting **start-ups and entrepreneurship** to address unemployment issues.
 
 
 
• **Kerala**__
 
 
• Kerala has a high literacy rate and a significant diaspora population, which has contributed to its **economic growth.**
 
• Urban unemployment in Kerala is influenced by the state's dependence on **remittances and service-based industries.**
 
• Despite the challenges, Kerala has made strides in sectors like **information technology and health care.**
